repo_type: greenfield (pre-code); planned polyglot monorepo (Go engine, TS viz)

domain-simulator-landscape.title: Simulator Landscape
domain-simulator-landscape.research_hints: SUMO, MATSim, CARLA, Aimsun, PTV VISSIM. Compare: time model, network representation, controller/agent APIs (e.g. SUMO's TraCI), replay support, licensing. Goal: steal proven ideas, avoid known pitfalls.

domain-traffic-flow-models.title: Traffic Flow Models
domain-traffic-flow-models.research_hints: Car-following: IDM, Gipps, Krauss (SUMO default). Lane-changing: MOBIL. Gap acceptance at unsignalized intersections and roundabouts. What fidelity is needed for credible congestion metrics at lane-level (not sub-lane) resolution.

domain-congestion-metrics.title: Congestion Metrics
domain-congestion-metrics.research_hints: HCM level-of-service, control delay, queue length, v/c ratio, travel-time reliability. How DOTs compare infrastructure alternatives. Output: the metric set our observability system must compute per lane/intersection/scenario.

domain-signal-control.title: Signal Control
domain-signal-control.research_hints: Phases, rings/barriers, fixed vs actuated vs adaptive, coordination and green waves, standard timing plan formats. Needed for signalized intersections and the civic-advocacy replay use case.

arch-time-model.title: Time Model
arch-time-model.research_hints: Fixed-tick authoritative loop vs discrete-event simulation vs hybrid. Prior art: multiplayer game servers (tick + client input events), SUMO (fixed step), MATSim (event-based). Determinism and replay requirements. Feeds ADR-0005.

arch-nats-backbone.title: NATS Backbone
arch-nats-backbone.research_hints: Subject taxonomy design; core NATS vs JetStream vs KV division of labor; JetStream replay semantics for deterministic playback; backpressure/slow-consumer handling with many controllers; embedding nats-server in a Go process vs docker-compose.

arch-road-graph-model.title: Road Graph Model
arch-road-graph-model.research_hints: Lane-level graph: nodes, edges, lanes, lane-to-lane connections, turn restrictions. How SUMO's .net.xml and osm2streets represent this. Geometry (polylines) vs topology separation.

arch-state-authority.title: State Authority
arch-state-authority.research_hints: Authoritative-server patterns: interest management (area-of-interest state fan-out), client-side prediction for human drivers, handling late/dropped controller inputs, snapshot vs delta state publishing.

concept-vehicle-controller-interface.title: Vehicle & Controller Interface
concept-vehicle-controller-interface.research_hints: Separate vehicle capabilities (size, accel profile) from operator/controller (AI policy, scripted, human). What the engine↔controller message contract carries: observations in, intents out. Compare SUMO TraCI and CARLA actor/agent APIs.

concept-scenario-format.title: Scenario Format
concept-scenario-format.research_hints: Scenario = network + demand (spawns/routes) + control config + metrics. Must be diffable for upgrade variants. Demand modeling basics (OD matrices, arrival rates). Recording format for replay (JetStream stream export?).

integration-osm-extraction.title: OSM Extraction
integration-osm-extraction.research_hints: OSM data model: ways, nodes, relations; lanes/turn:lanes/highway tags; turn restriction relations. Tooling: Overpass API, osmnx, osm2streets (A/B Street), SUMO's netconvert. Pipeline: bbox → clean lane-graph in our format.

integration-maplibre-realtime.title: MapLibre Realtime Viz
integration-maplibre-realtime.research_hints: Feeding live vehicle positions into MapLibre (GeoJSON source updates vs custom WebGL layer), congestion heatmaps on road geometry (line-color data-driven styling), update-rate limits, and the criteria for escalating to deck.gl overlay.
